items.label: Mail domain
items.description: The domain mail to your plugins' addresses arrives at, such as mail.acme.example.
items.long_description: Mail is matched by the part before the @ (and before a +). When this is empty mail to any domain is accepted; when it is set, only mail to this domain. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Most messages per sender per hour
items.description: A sender who sends more than this in an hour has the rest set aside, not delivered.
items.long_description: Stops mail loops and floods. Set-aside messages are kept and listed with the reason. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Keep handled messages (days)
items.description: Messages that were routed, answered or set aside are removed after this many days. 0 keeps them.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Keep unmatched messages (days)
items.description: Messages nobody has handled are removed after this many days. 0 keeps them.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.
